page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8y.small is an entry-level general purpose virtual machine instance running on the KVM hypervisor. The instance is powered by Alibaba's in-house arm64 Yitian YiTian710 processor operating at 2.75 GHz. It is provisioned with 1 dedicated physical core presenting 1 vCPU, 4.0 GB of system memory, and a standard 1:4 vCPU-to-memory ratio. Local disk storage is not included, requiring external block storage for persistent data, and the baseline network bandwidth is rated at 1 Gbps without hardware GPU acceleration.

Benchmark results demonstrate modest single-threaded throughput balanced by predictable execution from its dedicated CPU core. Single-core evaluations, including stress-ng (1776.78) and Geekbench (1375.0), rank within the average middle tier, alongside acceptable single-threaded data compression scores such as gzip compression at 27.99 GB/sec. However, because the instance features only a single execution thread, aggregate multi-core metrics, memory bandwidth (21.07 GB/sec large read, 8.2 GB/sec write), and total throughput workloads like static web serving (1.72 GB/sec) and Redis SET operations (1.68 million ops/sec) place in the lowest percentiles.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.g8y.small offers an economical entry point into ARM-based cloud environments, delivering dedicated compute performance without hyper-threading contention. Tradeoffs include limited multi-tasking headroom and the complete absence of local storage. The instance is suitable for lightweight background utilities, small microservices, lightweight web staging environments, monitoring agents, and low-traffic container deployments.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.g8y.small is an arm64 general purpose instance built on the custom 2.75 GHz Alibaba Yitian YiTian710 processor. The instance configuration includes 1 dedicated vCPU backed by 1 physical core, 4.0 GB of memory, and a 1 Gbps baseline network link, with no bundled local storage or GPU hardware. In benchmark tests, the instance delivers average single-core compute performance, as shown in Geekbench (1375.0) and stress-ng (1776.78), along with steady single-threaded compression throughput. Because resources are constrained to a single core, multi-threaded throughput and memory bandwidth remain in the lower tiers across comprehensive tests. The ecs.g8y.small represents a cost-efficient architecture for low-concurrency operations, making it suitable for lightweight microservices, monitoring nodes, background automation scripts, and low-traffic web hosting.
